papers.title: Unrestricted pro-modularity at the prime two
papers.result_title: Unrestricted pro-modularity at the prime two
papers.subject: Number theory
papers.summary: Every continuous odd absolutely irreducible two-dimensional 2-adic representation of G_{\mathbb Q} unramified outside finitely many primes occurs in a completed Hecke algebra at some odd tame level. Also proves classical modularity up to Tate twist for irreducible odd representations with these finiteness conditions that are de Rham at 2 with distinct Hodge–Tate weights, resolving the dyadic Fontaine–Mazur case without residual restrictions.

papers.title: The p-adic section conjecture
papers.result_title: The local p-adic section conjecture and global consequences
papers.subject: Number theory
papers.summary: Proves that rational points on every smooth proper geometrically connected curve of genus at least two over a finite extension of ℚp correspond bijectively to conjugacy classes of sections of its full arithmetic étale fundamental group. It also proves Grothendieck's section conjecture over ℚ for the modular curves X_0(N) and X_1(N) of genus at least two.

papers.title: Log abundance in numerical dimension one for threefolds in positive characteristic
papers.result_title: Log-canonical threefold abundance in numerical dimension one
papers.subject: Algebraic and complex geometry
papers.summary: Proves log abundance for projective log canonical threefold pairs over algebraically closed fields of characteristic p > 3 when the effective boundary is rational and the ℚ-Cartier adjoint is nef of numerical dimension one. The adjoint is semiample, without requiring the original variety to be terminal or ℚ-factorial.

papers.title: Canonical ampleness of compact hyperbolic Kähler manifolds
papers.result_title: Kobayashi’s canonical-ampleness conjecture
papers.subject: Algebraic and complex geometry
papers.summary: Every compact connected Kähler manifold of positive complex dimension with no nonconstant entire curve has ample canonical bundle and is therefore projective. This proves Kobayashi's canonical-ampleness conjecture in the smooth compact Kähler setting.

papers.title: A Gepner stability condition on every smooth quintic threefold
papers.result_title: Gepner symmetry and large-volume stability on threefolds
papers.subject: Algebraic and complex geometry
papers.summary: Proves Toda's Gepner conjecture for every smooth complex quintic threefold, constructing a numerical Bridgeland stability condition with the prescribed phase shift 2/5. Also constructs numerical Bridgeland stability conditions at every sufficiently large volume on all smooth projective complex threefolds with trivial canonical bundle, with the exact ordinary and square-root-Todd central charges.

papers.title: Pointwise Multiple Ergodic Averages for Mixing Transformations
papers.result_title: Pointwise multiple ergodic averages for mixing transformations
papers.subject: Dynamical systems and ergodic theory
papers.summary: Proves almost-everywhere convergence of consecutive multiple ergodic averages of every finite length for invertible mixing probability-preserving transformations. For each fixed tuple of bounded functions, the limit is the product of their integrals, along all positive averaging lengths. No mixing rate or standardness assumption on the probability space is required.

papers.title: Positivity of Serre's Intersection Multiplicity
papers.result_title: Serre’s intersection-multiplicity conjecture
papers.subject: Algebra
papers.summary: Proves strict positivity of Serre's intersection multiplicity \chi^R(M,N) for nonzero finitely generated modules over any regular local ring, provided M\otimes_R N has finite length and \dim M+\dim N=\dim R. This resolves the positivity conjecture, including ramified mixed characteristic.

papers.title: The Artinian Lex-Plus-Powers Betti Theorem
papers.result_title: Eisenbud–Green–Harris and lex-plus-powers
papers.subject: Algebra
papers.summary: Proves the Eisenbud–Green–Harris and lex-plus-powers conjectures over every characteristic-zero field. Any homogeneous ideal containing a regular sequence, of arbitrary length and degrees at least two, admits a lex-plus-powers ideal with the same Hilbert function and no smaller graded Betti numbers.

papers.title: Spectral scalar curvature and uniform Urysohn width
papers.result_title: Spectral scalar curvature, Urysohn width, and macroscopic dimension
papers.subject: Differential geometry
papers.summary: Every complete connected smooth boundaryless n-manifold, n ≥ 3, satisfying -4\Delta+\mathrm{Scal}\ge1 as a quadratic-form inequality admits a continuous map to a simplicial complex of dimension at most n-2 whose entire fibers have diameter bounded only by n in the original metric. This strengthens Gromov's width conclusion to spectral scalar curvature. Universal covers of closed positive-scalar-curvature manifolds also have continuous macroscopic dimension at most n-2 for every n ≥ 2.

papers.title: A counterexample to the nearby Lagrangian conjecture
papers.result_title: A counterexample to the nearby Lagrangian conjecture
papers.subject: Differential geometry
papers.summary: Disproves the unrestricted nearby Lagrangian conjecture. For some sufficiently large even N, constructs a closed exact embedded Lagrangian in T^*(S^9\times S^{N-1}) that is diffeomorphic to the base but not Hamiltonian isotopic to its zero section.

papers.title: A closed Ricci flow with bounded scalar curvature and finite-time curvature blowup
papers.result_title: Scalar curvature and finite-time Ricci-flow singularities
papers.subject: Differential geometry
papers.summary: Proves that a smooth Ricci flow on a closed four-manifold extends past any finite time at which scalar curvature remains uniformly bounded. A higher-dimensional counterexample has bounded scalar curvature but unbounded full curvature at its finite maximal time, disproving the unrestricted scalar-curvature extension conjecture.

papers.title: Interior regularity of planar Mumford–Shah minimizers
papers.result_title: The planar Mumford–Shah regularity conjecture and local weak-L4 gradient bounds
papers.subject: Partial differential equations
papers.summary: Resolves the interior regularity conjecture for reduced absolute planar Mumford–Shah minimizers with bounded fidelity data. Locally, the closed discontinuity set is a C^{1,\alpha} arc, a regular crack tip, or three arcs meeting at 120^\circ; only finitely many global connected components meet any compact interior region.

papers.title: Étale covers with a prescribed exterior sheet
papers.result_title: The local p-adic section conjecture and global consequences
papers.subject: Number theory
papers.summary: Proves that rational points on every smooth proper geometrically connected curve of genus at least two over a finite extension of ℚp correspond bijectively to conjugacy classes of sections of its full arithmetic étale fundamental group. It also proves Grothendieck's section conjecture over ℚ for the modular curves X_0(N) and X_1(N) of genus at least two.

papers.title: The Campana–Peternell conjecture in dimension six
papers.result_title: The Campana–Peternell conjecture in dimension six
papers.subject: Algebraic and complex geometry
papers.summary: Proves the Campana–Peternell conjecture in complex dimension six: every smooth connected complex projective Fano sixfold with nef tangent bundle is rational homogeneous.

papers.title: Continuous Phase Foliations Create Analytic Caustic Collars
papers.result_title: The near-boundary Birkhoff conjecture
papers.subject: Dynamical systems and ergodic theory
papers.summary: Resolves the near-boundary Birkhoff conjecture for smooth strictly convex planar billiards of positive curvature. Such a billiard is an ellipse whenever a full grazing annulus is continuously foliated by individually invariant essential curves. A continuous physical collar of smooth closed convex caustics also suffices.

papers.title: An integral counterexample to Gersten's conjecture
papers.result_title: Integral counterexamples to Gersten’s conjecture
papers.subject: Algebra
papers.summary: Disproves unrestricted integral Gersten injectivity in degrees 3 and 5. Two explicit two-dimensional ramified regular local rings of mixed characteristic (0,5) have nonzero integral K-theory classes that vanish over their fraction fields.

papers.title: The curve scaling limit of half-plane double dimers
papers.result_title: The double-dimer loop ensemble converges to CLE<sub>4</sub>
papers.subject: Probability and statistical mechanics
papers.summary: Resolves the half-plane Temperleyan form of the double-dimer scaling-limit conjecture: the complete loop ensemble formed by two independent dimer coverings of the Temperleyan square lattice converges to nested CLE<sub>4</sub>. Convergence matches every macroscopic loop as an unparametrized curve, upgrading convergence of loop observables to convergence of the loops themselves.

papers.title: Filtered products and boundary-preserving compression in complex cobordism
papers.result_title: Radius of comparison equals half the mean dimension
papers.subject: Operator algebras
papers.summary: For every minimal homeomorphism h of an infinite compact metrizable space X, the radius of comparison of C(X)\rtimes_h\mathbb Z equals \tfrac12\mathrm{mdim}(X,h), including infinite values. Zero mean dimension is equivalent to the small boundary property, Jiang–Su stability and finite nuclear dimension; in this case nuclear dimension is at most one.

papers.title: The Solomon–Yau least-volume theorem
papers.result_title: The Solomon–Yau least-volume conjecture
papers.subject: Differential geometry
papers.summary: Proves the Solomon–Yau least-volume conjecture for minimal hypersurfaces of round spheres. For every m ≥ 2, a closed connected minimal immersion into the unit sphere S^{m+1} with non-totally-geodesic image has volume at least that of the smallest minimal Clifford product, counting covering multiplicity.

papers.title: Ambiently homeomorphic isolated hypersurfaces of multiplicities two and three
papers.result_title: Counterexamples to Zariski’s multiplicity conjecture
papers.subject: Algebraic and complex geometry
papers.summary: Disproves Zariski's multiplicity conjecture by constructing reduced holomorphic hypersurface germs that are ambiently homeomorphic but have different multiplicities. The examples include hypersurfaces in ℂ<sup>4</sup> with isolated critical points and multiplicities four and five.

papers.title: Anticanonical nonvanishing from smooth semipositivity
papers.result_title: Anticanonical nonvanishing in every dimension
papers.subject: Algebraic and complex geometry
papers.summary: If X is a smooth connected complex projective variety and -K_X admits a smooth Hermitian metric with nonnegative curvature, then H^0(X,-mK_X)\ne0 for some m > 0. Thus smooth semipositivity forces a nonzero section of a positive tensor power of the anticanonical bundle in every dimension.

papers.title: Existential–universal real sentences in the counting hierarchy
papers.result_title: Existential–universal real sentences in the counting hierarchy
papers.subject: Theoretical computer science
papers.summary: Proves that the existential theory of the reals lies in the counting hierarchy. More generally, truth of existential–universal real sentences can be decided at one fixed level of that hierarchy, even when their integer polynomials are specified by arithmetic circuits.
